data.one_liner: An iOS-like progressive blur implementation for Flutter using shaders.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ProgressiveBlurWidget that applies a gradient or custom texture-based blur effect over child widgets. Supports tint color customization and leverages flutter_shaders.
use_when: You want to create iOS-style progressive blur effects over your Flutter UI
You need gradient blur transitions using shaders
avoid_when: You are targeting web with CanvasKit where performance is reported to be terrible
You need a production-ready package with stable APIs and guaranteed optimal performance
strengths: Easy to use widget API with gradient and custom texture support
weaknesses: Early experimental version with suboptimal performance and potential API changes
Terrible performance on web with CanvasKit
